description: This is the main front-end React component for a minimal Tic Tac Toe game. It manages game state, player turns, winner detection, and UI rendering, including a reset functionality.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Function to evaluate the current board state and determine if a player has won, returning the winner ('X', 'O') or null if no winner.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Helper to check if the board is completely filled indicating a tie if no winner has been found.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on a cell; updates game state, checks for a winner, and manages turn switching.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game, clears the board, and sets the current player to 'X'.
